描述_EN: the museum asked more than sixty people in shenzhen to propose a design object that told a story about their city and the result was an exhibition of twenty-three things and twenty-three stories about the place. the museum opened its own space dedicated to rapid response collecting in july 2014. the invitation to participate in the bi-city biennale enabled the museum to engage with this fast-changing city and to road test the recently introduced rapid response collecting strand. chen says that the shenzhen economy will soon not be so dependent on this kind of production. for chen, the stickers, applied to fake products to make them look more authentic, are ‘a testament to the ingenuity and thoroughness of the shanzhai industry that has helped propel shenzhen these past 30 years. but at the same time, they hint at their own obsolescence. today shenzhen is the world’s third busiest container port, with a population with an average age of the less than thirty and almost entirely composed of recent migrants. shanzhai products, counterfeit or faked consumer goods, are an international cliché of chinese low-cost manufacturing. shenzhen, china’s first special economic zone is located at the tip of the pearl river delta. by exhibiting everyday objects, the show placed centre stage the realities of urban life, of industry and of commercial and social change. the city grew from a modest fishing town into a vast, sprawling metropolis of more than fifteen million in just thirty-five years, through manufacturing, trade and relentless commercial energy. counterfeit stickers, 2013 collected on the occasion of the exhibition v&a in shenzhen: rapid response collecting, staged at the 5th bi-city biennale of urbanism and architecture, the value factory, shenzhen. at some point in the not-too-distant future, these stickers – and all they imply – will be a relic of an earlier era.’ the shenzhen exhibition was the first test of rapid response collecting, a new approach intended to make museum collecting more responsive to global events, and to situate design in immediate relation to moments of political or social change. these stickers, a by-product of the shanzhai fake goods industry, are applied to counterfeit electronic products to make them appear more authentic. these counterfeit stickers were suggested by aric chen, curator of design and architecture at m+ in hong kong.
描述_ZN: 博物馆要求深圳的60多人提出一个讲述他们城市故事的设计品，结果是一个由23件东西和23个地方的故事组成的展览。 博物馆在2014年7月开放了自己的空间，专门用于快速反应收藏。 参加双城双年展的邀请使博物馆能够参与到这个快速变化的城市中，并对最近推出的快速反应收藏系列进行测试。 陈说，深圳的经济很快就会不那么依赖这种生产了。 陈说，这些贴纸被贴在假货上，使它们看起来更真实，是 "对过去30年帮助推动深圳的山寨工业的独创性和彻底性的证明。 但与此同时，他们也暗示了自己的过时。 今天，深圳是世界上第三繁忙的集装箱港口，人口平均年龄不到30岁，几乎完全由新移民组成。 山寨产品，假冒或伪造的消费品，是中国低成本制造业的一个国际惯例。 深圳，中国的第一个经济特区，位于珠江三角洲的顶端。 通过展出日常用品，展览将城市生活、工业以及商业和社会变革的现实置于中心位置。 通过制造业、贸易和不懈的商业活力，该城市在短短35年内从一个普通的渔镇发展成为一个拥有1500多万人口的庞大的大都市。 伪造的贴纸，2013年，在深圳第五届城市与建筑双城双年展上收集的展览V&A：快速反应收集，在深圳的价值工厂举行。 在不远的将来，这些贴纸--以及它们所暗示的--将成为早期时代的遗物。"深圳的展览是对快速反应收藏的第一次测试，这种新方法旨在使博物馆收藏对全球事件做出更多的反应，并将设计与政治或社会变革的时刻紧密联系起来。 这些贴纸是山寨假货行业的副产品，被贴在假冒的电子产品上，使它们看起来更真实。 这些伪造的贴纸是由香港M+的设计和建筑策展人Aric Chen提出的。
